architecture.mechanism: Semantic matching between a knowledge graph and an object classifier to identify task-relevant states.
architecture.intervention: Implement a semantic communication layer in the shifter recognition system that maps raw sensor voltage patterns to a predefined knowledge graph of gear states, using semantic matching to confirm the 'Park' position even if signal integrity is degraded.
architecture.expected_effect: Reliable detection and confirmation of the park gear position by compensating for bit errors or ambiguous sensor signals through context-aware semantic validation.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject simulated high-bit-error noise into the shifter position sensor data stream and verify if the system correctly identifies the 'Park' state via semantic matching where a traditional threshold-based detector fails.
